name: review-gemini-advisory
about: #190: with the runner's gemini block on (advisory, the default), an approved review gets a second opinion: the fake agy reports two findings on the diff (one high, one low), a Claude adjudication turn agrees with both, and the runner posts one 'Second opinion (Gemini)' comment, attaches gemini-findings.json and records the counts. The approval stands; the thread says so, and the board shows the counts on the card and the item's page. Land merges by hand.
